Acceptable locations for this remote role are Michigan (ideally eastern Michigan), or northern Ohio.

Summary This position is responsible for identifying product requirements and driving technology development projects related to business growth of thermoplastic elastomer (TPE) compounds. Requirements include strong plastics and/or rubber materials and technology skills and, excellent skills in customer relationships, business development, project management, teamwork, organization, and communication. This person is the materials subject matter expert for the customer-facing team.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing development activities associated with TPE materials.
  • Pursues new business opportunities through diligent customer and market development efforts:
    • Identifies strategic markets and customers;
    • Determines material requirements and specifications for targeted applications;
    • Collaborates with Audia Elastomers product development engineers to develop material solutions to meet customer needs;
    • Interprets sample results and provides data sheets and other material physical property information to customers;
    • Coordinates and attends customer molding trials as necessary, providing feedback to product development regarding direction of future work;
    • Presents a formalized data package of developed material(s) for customer approval(s).
  • Interfaces with converters, Tiers, and OEMs to achieve and document Audia Elastomers product approvals.
  • May support non-automotive applications in the given geography where expertise allows, and/or where a converter serves multiple market segments.
  • Effectively promotes Audia Elastomers products and organizational capabilities.
  • Submits call reports and monthly activity summaries concerning customer-related activities as requested by manager.
  • Provides timely response to customer inquiries and complaints to ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Performs other duties and assignments as directed by manager.
  • Performs all duties safely and in compliance with documentation outlined in the Safety, Health & Environmental and defined quality management systems.

Recommended Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in engineering, science, or equivalent, and/or 5-7 years of experience with elastomeric (preferred) or plastic (acceptable) materials in the automotive industry
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage technical strength to develop new business.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong, long-term customer relationships.
  • Ability to work seamlessly with commercial and product development teams to develop appropriate strategies to address customer and/or market need(s).
  • Excellent communication skills, self-starter, sense of urgency, personable, and well organized.
  • Skilled in the use of basic computer software, including word-processing and spreadsheets.
  • Self-sufficient in terms of time management and support.

Working Conditions

  • Environment – Commercial and/or home office as appropriate.
  • Travel – Frequent travel, generally over 50% and can include international travel.

Responsibility for Safety, Health & Environmental

  • Individual is expected to perform job duties safely and in compliance with documentation outlined in the Safety, Health & Environmental system.

Responsibility for Quality

Individual is expected to perform job duties in compliance with defined management system requirements

Únete a ALTEN MÉXICO, donde nos especializamos en brindar servicios de consultoría en ingeniería y tecnología de primer nivel en diversos sectores. Como filial del Grupo ALTEN, hemos ofrecido soluciones innovadoras durante más de 30 años, apoyando a empresas líderes en Automotriz, Aeroespacial, Telecomunicaciones y más.

Estamos buscando un Body Exterior Quality Engineer - Jr para unirse a nuestro dinámico equipo. En esta posición, serás responsable de supervisar los aspectos de calidad de los componentes exteriores de carrocería para aplicaciones automotrices, asegurando el cumplimiento tanto de las especificaciones del cliente como de los requisitos normativos.

Responsabilidades clave

  • Implementar acciones para mejorar el Costo Por Unidad (CPU) y el gasto en garantías para los sistemas de Exteriores de Carrocería.
  • Rastrear y analizar datos de calidad para identificar y atender problemas de alto impacto.
  • Liderar y monitorear acciones de Total Value Management (TVM) para la reducción de costos y mejora de procesos.
  • Supervisar las pruebas de validación para todas las iniciativas de reducción de costos relacionadas con los sistemas de Exteriores de Carrocería.
  • Garantizar la correcta ejecución de los procesos de manufactura para las ideas de calidad aplicadas a Exteriores de Carrocería.
  • Monitorear y reportar métricas clave como el Costo Por Unidad (CPU) y Reparaciones por cada 1000 unidades (R/1000).
  • Validar que todas las iniciativas de mejora de calidad cumplan con los estándares de la empresa y de la industria.
  • Crear y gestionar informes de estado completos sobre todos los proyectos de calidad.

Requirements

  • Licenciatura en Ingeniería Mecánica, Ingeniería Industrial o un campo relacionado.
  • Al menos 1 año de experiencia en ingeniería de calidad automotriz, específicamente en sistemas de Exteriores de Carrocería (Body Exterior).
  • Experiencia liderando iniciativas de reducción de costos y mejora en garantías.
  • Dominio de Sistemas de Gestión de Calidad (QMS) y principios de Manufactura Esbelta (Lean Manufacturing).
  • Experiencia con Total Value Management (TVM) y metodologías de optimización de costos.
  • Sólidos conocimientos en pruebas de validación y procesos de manufactura.
  • Familiaridad con estándares de calidad automotriz (por ejemplo, ISO 9001, IATF 16949).
  • Dominio de herramientas de análisis de datos (por ejemplo, Excel, Minitab o equivalentes).
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas y análisis.
  • Fuertes capacidades de comunicación y colaboración con equipos multifuncionales.
  • Capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos y priorizar tareas de manera efectiva.
  • VISA y pasaporte vigentes (indispensable)
  • Inglés avanzado (indispensable)

Benefits

  • Sueldo base
  • Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores (incluye plan dental y visión)
  • 15 días de aguinaldo
  • 25% de prima vacacional
  • 12 días de vacaciones (A partir del primer año)
  • Seguro social
  • Vales de despensa quincenales

About the project:

  • The project is dedicated to one of the European customers, and main focus is on the development of the Body Controller for some of the functionalities
  • It is in the production phase, but there are change requests from customer for update of existing SW set up and creation new ones for upcoming new car lines and new functionalities.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Giving direction to follow existing AS&UX standards in the SW development process
  • Collecting and analysing SW requirements,

- Defining SW architecture,

- Preparing SW design documentation,

- Programming SW modules,

  • Prepare and perform tests to verify SW work products.
  • Supporting System Engineer in defining system architecture.
  • Keeping contact with clients in the rea of software tasks.
  • Play a role of mentor in solving technical problems.
  • Force to accomplish tasks in accordance to AS&UX and TCK quality standards and schedules.
  • Co-ordination and/or leading SW activities during project development.
  • Support co-operation with local and remote AS&UX teams.

SKILLS:

  • MSc degree in Electronics or Computer Science, or related
  • Great expert in a specific technical domain

  • Very good knowledge of tools for programming micro-controllers and processors
  • Very good knowledge of SW engineering tools supporting the software production process
  • Experience in direct contact with the Customer

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS:

- leadership

- Experience in coordinating SW project

PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE AND FRAMEWORK:

- C

- Python

SAE Industry Technologies Consortia (ITC), Performance Review Institute (PRI) and SAE International (SAE), deliver shared solutions to industry's common challenges.

Join us and create a higher standard for a better world.

The Principal Engineer provides general technical and engineering management expertise to the best practices, standards, and technical report development process. Facilitates and manages working groups and/or user forum projects developing applicable industry guidance, standards and technical reports. Business activities include but are not limited to supporting the development, management and marketing of standards & technical reports, qualification/certification programs, referee materials, cooperative research and identifying markets for the same. Supports implementation of company strategy and continuous improvement initiatives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Applies job specific technical/ engineering expertise in project management and product development. Supports industry through demonstrated ability to facilitate and influence task groups to achieve industry desired outcomes
  • Support and perform product development / project engineering tasks for working groups, and/or user forums as assigned, including:
    • Develop proposals for statement of work for new and revised standards & technical reports
    • Support projects, make plans to accomplish goals and facilitate the integration of technical activities
    • Develop industry guidance, standards and technical reports, coordinating responses to industry comments and coordinating with related industry groups and representing the subcommittees and working groups in meetings and forums
    • Support and perform technical oversight report generation/assessment as directed with strict confidentiality and compliance with procedural and regulatory requirements; conduct technical oversight as required; review/update reports; follow up and close non-conformances; ensure effective closure of reports for timely release of documents; provide technical summary reports to the assigned task group; quick elevation of issues for resolution.
    • Supports the work programs of assigned subcommittees and working groups, including technical planning, meeting logistics, facilitation, and meeting report preparation. Function as the focal point for committee activities by writing and issuing agendas and minutes, resolving problems, communicating information, answering inquiries, etc.
  • Plans and conducts technical meetings, prepares materials, and facilitates technical sessions and seminars. Prepares technical meeting reports and presentation of results for industry coordination.
  • Supports the planning of and contributes to the technical sessions at Industry Conferences & Technical Meetings. Support the program communication strategy plan. Provide input to the plan and support workshops, appearances and exhibits, as assigned. Also support and help to coordinate the development of marketing materials, as applicable.
  • Execute straightforward tasks to support leadership committees as assigned and required.
  • Provide limited support of straightforward new initiatives, as assigned. Recommend process improvements for assigned programs. Identify gaps/problems and report to appropriate management. Participates in user-experience research to identify obstacles, improve ease-of-use, customer satisfaction and inform future product and service development, as applicable.
  • Support the program strategic plan through alignment with deadlines, goals, and milestones.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS


  • 6 years’ experience in automotive or automated vehicle engineering, project management, project engineering, or technical management roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, science, or business management.
  • Technical/engineering expertise with experience in the areas of responsibility for technical standards use, development, or auditing (automated or automotive industry use preferred).
  • Strong interpersonal and communications skills along with excellent analytical, writing, editing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to organize effectively, carry out independent action, work on simultaneous assignments, and perform functions of a confidential manner.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Global and cultural sensitivities.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Strong teamwork, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of trade association operations.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • Master’s degree in, engineering, science, quality, finance, or business management
  • Role-related certifications.
  • 2 years of experience managing volunteer committees, or similar experience.
  • Strong computer skills including MS Office and typical office application software; Knowledge of software and database systems.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS


Standard business hours with flexibility for global meetings.

  • Remote office with reliable, secure internet connection and proper ergonomic setup.
  • Frequent virtual meetings; occasional travel (up to 30%) for technical conferences or committee sessions.
  • Must maintain a confidential and secure workspace and comply with company data security policies.

#ITC

ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION

SAE Industry Technologies Consortia® (SAE ITC) enables organizations to define and pilot best practices. SAE ITC industry stakeholders are able to work together to effectively solve common problems, achieve mutual benefit for industry, and create business value.

The Performance Review Institute® (PRI) is the world leader in facilitating collaborative supply chain oversight programs, quality management systems approvals, and professional development in industries where safety and quality are shared values.

SAE International® (SAEI) is a global organization serving the mobility sector, predominantly in the aerospace, automotive and commercial-vehicle industries, fostering innovation, and enabling engineering professionals. Since 1905, SAE has harnessed the collective wisdom of engineers around the world to create industry-enabling standards. Likewise, SAE members have advanced their knowledge and understanding of mobility engineering through our information resources, professional development, and networking.

Fullsight is a shared services group working across three affiliate organizations, SAE ITC, SAE International, and Performance Review Institute (PRI), uniformly delivering HR, IT, Legal, Customer Success, Finance, and Procurement services, which enables us to distribute resources across all parts of our businesses.

EEO CLAUSE

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Job Description

DUTIES: Responsible for executing both manual and automated test scripts to verify Infotainment component function and performance requirements. Configure benches to support specific test scenarios. Characterize and document defects including identifying steps to reproduce, linking failures to requirements, and collecting all associated test logs. Develop and update test cases as required. Interact with multiple engineering fields including Systems Engineering, Software Development, Validation, and Suppliers to support defect resolution. Plan and manage execution of weekly verification testing. Manage weekly build promotions including sanity test planning, critical issue escalation and develop response to additional test requests. Coordinate test assignments for a large multi-functional team to ensure that all test requirements are met. Lead, collaborate, and improve testing on Infotainment ECU. Verify operation of Infotainment features that function on CAN, Ethernet and LIN communication protocols. Provide regular status updates and complete documentation and test results. Perform diagnostics, partial network, and DPS calibration testing. 100% telecommuting available.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field of study. Five (5) years of experience as a Software Test Engineer – Vehicle Software Management, System Test Lead, Senior Staff Systems Engineer, Software Systems Engineer II, Senior Test Engineer, Test Engineer or related occupation. Five (5) years of experience in the following: Automotive SW Testing or Development, including experience with test automation and test or software architecture; LAN/CAN vehicle communication system and CAN based monitoring tools; Vehicle Electrical Architecture and Subsystem Features in the Infotainment domain; and CAPL Programming and Python Programming. Three (3) years of experience in the following: Operating Systems including Android, Linux and QNX; Project and Test Management; and Requirement Analysis and Systems Engineering. Two (2) years of experience in the following: In-Vehicle Network and Diagnostics, Diagnostic Testing.

Bei TE Connectivity geben wir Ihnen Raum zur beruflichen Entfaltung, und die Möglichkeit über Länder und Kulturen hinweg mit Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten, mit dem Ziel eine sicherere, nachhaltige, produktive und vernetzte Zukunft zu gestalten.

Jobübersicht

Der Customer Quality Agent (m/w/d) spielt eine entscheidende Rolle beim Aufbau und der Pflege hochwertiger Kundenbeziehungen in der EMIA-Region. In dieser Funktion arbeitet er gemäß den festgelegten Qualitätsstandards und -vorschriften und agiert sowohl als Vermittler als auch als Qualitätsexperte für interne und externe Stakeholder.

Es handelt sich um eine Remote-Position, die idealerweise von einem der folgenden Standorte aus besetzt wird: Deutschland, Tschechien, Ungarn oder Polen.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören:

  • Betreuung kundenspezifischer Qualitätsanforderungen innerhalb der EMIA-Region, einschließlich:

    • Customer Scorecards
    • PPAP/PPA-Scorecards und -Elemente (Production Part Approval Process / Produktionsfreigabeverfahren)
    • Finanzielle Aspekte

  • Steuerung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen sowie der damit verbundenen Freigabeprozesse

  • Sicherstellung einer zeitnahen Bearbeitung und Beantwortung von Kundenanfragen

  • Unterstützung beim Ausbau von Marktanteilen und dem weiteren Wachstum von TE

Durch die effektive Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen Kundenerwartungen und internen Möglichkeiten trägt der Customer Quality Agent (m/w/d) dazu bei, langfristige Partnerschaften zu fördern und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen innerhalb der gesamten EMIA-Organisation voranzutreiben.

Stellenanforderungen

Kundenbetreuung

  • Bereitstellung von kundenseitigem Support vor Ort bei Bedarf sowie aktive Steuerung der Kommunikation mit Kunden zu qualitätsrelevanten Themen.
  • Pflege eines fundierten Verständnisses der kundenspezifischen Anforderungen sowie der Geschäftsprozesse von Tier-1-Kunden.
  • Nachverfolgung und Bearbeitung von kritischen („roten“) Themen in Customer Scorecards für Quality EMIA.
  • Gewährleistung eines exzellenten Kundenservices, einer professionellen Kommunikation und einer hohen Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit als Marktführer im Bereich Konnektivität.
  • Übernahme einer Schlüsselrolle bei der Einleitung von Eskalationsprozessen innerhalb der TE-Organisation.
  • Vermittlungsfunktion zwischen Kunden und den TE-Fachbereichen bei sämtlichen Qualitätsproblemen.
  • Leitung und Steuerung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit den TE-Produktionsstandorten zur Erfüllung der Kundenerwartungen.
  • Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten in Zusammenarbeit mit Kompetenzzentren und Centers of Excellence.
  • Leitung von „Customer Read Across“- und „Lessons Learned“-Aktivitäten innerhalb der EMIA-Region.
  • Unterstützung und Begleitung von Kunden bei Audits an TE-Standorten.

Zusammenarbeit

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und Kundenservice.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit TE PE Resident Engineers, Customer Engineering Teams, FLE sowie weiteren Funktionen zur Unterstützung strategisch wichtiger Kunden.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Performance and Systems Team.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit BIQ (Build in Quality) bzw. den 14Q Principal Experts in den Werken.
  • Partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Qualitätsabteilungen der TE-Produktionsstandorte in EMIA und Förderung von Strategien zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung (z. B. Green Scorecard Strategy). Ca. 40 bis 60 % Reisetätigkeit bzw. Vor-Ort-Präsenz.
  • Aufbau technischer Expertenteams zur Bearbeitung kritischer Kundenreklamationen und Problemlösungen.
  • Übergabe regionsübergreifender Eskalationen an die jeweils zuständigen globalen Teams.

Qualitätssicherung und Rework-Management

  • Verantwortung für die Überwachung lokaler Sortieraktivitäten bei Dienstleistern und Partnerunternehmen (CoPQ) sowie für das Management von Nacharbeitsmaßnahmen beim Kunden; einschließlich Kostenverhandlungen zur Vermeidung bzw. Reduzierung von Qualitätskosten.
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Prozessen zur Vermeidung zusätzlicher finanzieller Belastungen.
  • Verbesserung der Qualitätskennzahlen beim Kunden mit dem Ziel einer Reduzierung der Garantie- und Gewährleistungskosten innerhalb der EMIA-Region.
  • Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit sowie Eskalation von EMIA-Qualitätsberichten (z. B. Customer Scorecards, PPAP-Statusberichte/-Scorecards und Verbesserungspläne) auf regelmäßiger Basis.
  • Beitrag zum Rückstellungsprozess (Accruals Process) bei schwerwiegenden Qualitätsproblemen mit voraussichtlich erheblichen finanziellen Auswirkungen.
  • Abstimmung von Qualitätszielen mit den Kunden, um ein gemeinsames Verständnis sowie eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung mit den entsprechenden internen und externen Standorten und Organisationen sicherzustellen.
  • Unterstützung der TE-Produktionsstandorte in EMIA bei der Eskalation der 5D-/8D-Kommunikation gegenüber Kunden.

Technische Expertise

Job Title: Test Lead

Job Type: Full-Time/Contract - 2 years (renewable)

Location: Barbados (Remote)

Role Summary:

The Test Lead has overall responsibility for the management of the entire test work-package on a project/initiative effort, i.e. managing and maintaining an effective test process to ensure the delivery of a high quality product against business requirements. In order to fulfill this role, the Test Lead must possess sound knowledge, appreciation and acceptance of the various test disciplines and possess the ability to effectively execute the test process throughout the life cycle of the project/initiative.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leading the test activities from planning to implementation
  • Collaborating with the Business Analyst to review, analyze and identify gaps in the functional and non-functional requirements
  • Determine the need for creating and managing the different test plans (Master Plan &/or Detailed Test Plan)
  • Preparing test plan (s) and obtaining the requisite approvals
  • Work closely with the Business to determine appropriate business scenarios for testing.
  • Designing, constructing and documenting traceability matrices
  • Performing an assessment of risks related to testing for the project and developing a test strategy and plan to mitigate the risks
  • Creating the required testing artifacts
  • Tracking test progress and providing regular status reports to the Test Manager or Project Manager
  • Tracking and management of Variance Records, severity and statuses
  • Reporting test metrics as required by the Business and Project Management
  • Escalating testing related issues as required to the Test Manager, Business and Project Management
  • Coordinating and ensuring the completion of administrative activities that impact the Test Team e.g. Systems access.
  • Preparing and delivering the Test Completion report to the Business and Project Management upon completion of testing for review and approval.
  • Retaining the appropriate artifacts as per audit or legal requirements for the Line (s) of Business
  • Managing the test team through the completion of their activities outlined below:
  1. Designing, constructing and documenting traceability matrices, test cases and test scripts
  2. Executing planned tests, comparing actual to expected results, and documenting the outcome
  3. Creating variance records and assigning the appropriate severity level
  4. Performing re-tests and documenting the results until a successful outcome is achieved
  5. Reporting progress and issues during test planning, test preparation, and test wrap-up as outlined in the test plan
  6. Communicating day-to-day testing progress and issues
